label: Same material extension
resolution: Exact constituent coincidence is indexed by one time; global extensional equality compares entire time/token occurrence sets. A correspondence preserves all represented observations without proving ontological identity. Material tokens are not all mereological parts: self-parts distinguish the overlapping temporal wholes. Enduring numerical persistence is a separate framework commitment, disputed by one-object and sortal-relative rivals. No metaphysical possibility, causal relation, substantial unity or root conclusion is inferred.
